review_comments.body:
** Major** · **Stability & Availability** · **Heavy lift** **Handle `thinking` blocks before switching the default model.** Claude Sonnet 5.5 runs adaptive thinking when a request has no `thinking` field. Its responses can begin with `thinking` content blocks. `async-anthropic` 0.6.0 deserializes response content into `MessageContent`, which has no `thinking` variant. A response that contains a `thinking` block can fail to deserialize. Default `simple_prompt` and chat requests then return an error instead of an answer. Streamed `ContentBlockStart` events use the same enum and can fail the same way. Either handle `thinking` blocks in the response types, or choose a default model that does not think by default. For tool-use loops, pass `thinking` blocks back unchanged with the tool results. The current assistant-message conversion has no way to carry them.
